ambient_events: A child looks up at the door a moment before anybody reaches it.
Chalk goes back in the tin. All of it, without being asked.
Somebody very small is crying, briefly, and is dealt with, and stops.
description: A single room with a yard walled off in front of it, and in the yard a swing, a sand pit, and a low fence around a patch of dirt where things have been planted in rows by somebody about four years old.
name: The Creche
